name: Weslin
title: Guild Artisan
examine: Fingertips stained with dye, wood shavings in the hair. The yard's three trades answer to one pair of hands.
lines: Leather, thread, or timber? The good patterns cost coin, fair warning.
A pattern on paper is half the work done before you sit down.
The guild wrote these down so the craft wouldn't die with the crafter. Buying one keeps the ink wet.
Measure twice. The hide only forgives once.
